_: Measured ground truth for candidates_v3.json (round 3): the owner's 2026-11-08 read plus what seven open models did with each kept pair (traced 2026-11-08 as data/simulated/agscen_20261108.json; engine #153). Per model: the top next word on each side, its care level under data/urgency_tiers.draft.json (the study's tier vocabulary and urgency_shift.py's rules), the class (downgrade = the everyday side's top word names a lower level; upgrade, lateral, or uninformative when a top word has no level), and the change in the clinical target's probability (penalty, everyday minus clinical). Pair summary: downgrade is true when at least one model downgraded and more models downgraded than upgraded. Exploratory: 62 hand-authored pairs, one sample each, not a study result.
